slicer.api.auth: Send an API credential in the Authorization header as Bearer <token>. Its scope decides which routes it reaches. Create one in
slicer.api.example: Slice a project from start to end
slicer.api.failuresNote: A job that was taken can still fail later. Its state is then failed, and error.code is one of these.
slicer.api.intro: This module is an HTTP API around the PrusaSlicer command line. A script, a printer or another program on your network sends a 3MF project, and the module slices it on this server and writes the G-code into a storage.
slicer.api.setup: Set these once in your shell
slicer.api.step.download: Download the G-code from the storage.
slicer.api.step.poll: Read the job until it has finished.
slicer.api.step.store: Put the project into a storage. The server passes at most 1 MiB to a module, so a larger project goes this way.
slicer.api.step.submit: Ask for a job. This one slices bed 2 and the build items 0 and 2, counted from 0 in the project's build list.
slicer.api.step.upload: A small project can be sent with the job instead of steps 1 and 2.
slicer.api.title: Slicing over the network
